purpose: Tested OpenDocument/open-format compatibility matrix for Archiv ingestion, retrieval, citation, and output (issue #37). Every family claim is re-verified by tests/test_format_matrix.py against live local ingestion runs; unsupported formats are rejected explicitly, never silently accepted.

families.detection: suffix plus bounded UTF-8 decoding; undecodable content fails closed
families.preview_render: the preserved bytes are the truth; any text viewer can show them
families.encryption: no encryption layer exists; bytes are preserved verbatim
known_limits: line locators only; no paragraph or section semantics

families.encryption: undecryptable inputs fail closed during normalization; no password handling is attempted
known_limits: text follows content-stream order, not visual layout

pages without native text yield conditional visual_ocr segments only when local Tesseract and Poppler tools are present (page, line, and pixel-region locators); with tools absent ingestion stays valid with no searchable text

families.detection: suffix plus native InPage100/InPage300 stream identification inside a bounded CFB container; suffix spoofing and unknown variants fail closed
